old_problem: The source targets GFX block2 but calls the block2 query a UMC counter; implicit device target, proprietary tool semantics, exact log/counter oracle and recovery remain unapproved.
disposition_reason: The repository confirms block2 is used for the GFX command and OOB GC/ext58 cases, but contains no approved AMD guide proving what `-d 0 -b 2 -q 1` returns. Treating `UMC` as a typo without that authority would invent the PASS oracle. ED-16 therefore keeps the decision pending while the complete parameterized test is preserved.
decision_basis: Directly read Reliability row197 all18 XLSX cells and history2578.
Compared same-library block2 GFX and UMC references; they expose the wording conflict but do not authorize rewriting the proprietary counter label.
Preserved exact block2/subtype0/type2 stimulus, before/after query, time-correlated logs, safety and Recovery.
No injection, module change or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD in-band GFX correctable block2 counter-delta validation
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved correctable GFX event is accepted, produces attributable driver evidence and changes the vendor-defined block2 counter without escalation.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras version/hash/license and matching driver
AMD authority defining block2/subtype0/type2 and block2 query label
Expected driver fields, counter delta and quiet window
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records device/log/counter baseline, validates the implicit target and vendor semantics, loads the approved ras_enable=1 state, runs `sudo amdgpuras -b 2 -s 0 -t 2` once, captures complete time-correlated logs, runs `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 2 -q 1`, evaluates the approved delta, then verifies final GPU health.
test_case.expected_result: The one-shot command reports success; the approved GFX driver signature and vendor-defined block2 counter delta are attributable to the selected GPU; no uncorrectable/fatal escalation or continuing storm remains.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved counter identity, clean baseline, one injection, exact log signature, expected delta, quiet window and healthy recovery. Calling an unexplained block2 value UMC, generic dmesg text, wrong target, escalation or instability cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle GPU SUT and explicit correctable-injection approval.
Do not execute until block2 counter meaning and target are approved.
Preserve logs; do not clear evidence.
One injection only; no automatic retry or reset.
expected_evidence: GPU UUID/OAM/BDF, driver and tool identity
Single command output and full timestamped driver/RAS logs
Approved counter-definition reference and delta assessment
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, fatal/uncorrectable escalation, counter storm or lost GPU, stop and preserve evidence; use only owner-approved OOB/reset/rebind/reboot recovery, restore ras_enable state and never reinject automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Title/command identify GFX block2 while criteria name the same block2 query UMC; no approved guide in the repository resolves which label/oracle is authoritative.
